questions.question:
Persons A, B, C, D, E and F sit around a circular table facing the centre, in this order clockwise: A, B, C, D, E, F.

Who sits opposite A?
questions.explanation: In six seats, the opposite is three seats away: A → B → C → D. So D.

questions.question:
Persons A, B, C, D, E and F sit around a circular table facing the centre, in this order clockwise: A, B, C, D, E, F.

Who sits at the immediate left of B?
questions.explanation: Facing the centre, left is the next person clockwise: C.

questions.question:
Persons A, B, C, D, E and F sit around a circular table facing the centre, in this order clockwise: A, B, C, D, E, F.

Who sits at the immediate right of B?
questions.explanation: Right is the next person anticlockwise: A.

questions.question:
Persons A, B, C, D, E and F sit around a circular table facing the centre, in this order clockwise: A, B, C, D, E, F.

Who sits second to the left of E?
questions.explanation: Going clockwise from E: F (1st), A (2nd).

questions.question:
Persons A, B, C, D, E and F sit around a circular table facing the centre, in this order clockwise: A, B, C, D, E, F.

How many persons sit between A and D (clockwise from A)?
questions.explanation: Between A and D going clockwise are B and C: 2 persons.

questions.question:
Persons A, B, C, D, E and F sit around a circular table facing the centre, in this order clockwise: A, B, C, D, E, F.

Who sits between C and E?
questions.explanation: D sits between C and E.

questions.question:
Persons K, L, M, N, O, P, Q and R sit around a circular table facing the centre, in this order clockwise: K, L, M, N, O, P, Q, R.

Who sits opposite K?
questions.explanation: In eight seats, the opposite is four seats away: K → L → M → N → O. So O.

questions.question:
Persons K, L, M, N, O, P, Q and R sit around a circular table facing the centre, in this order clockwise: K, L, M, N, O, P, Q, R.

Who is third to the right of N?
questions.explanation: Right is anticlockwise: N → M → L → K. So K.

questions.question:
Persons K, L, M, N, O, P, Q and R sit around a circular table facing the centre, in this order clockwise: K, L, M, N, O, P, Q, R.

Who is second to the left of Q?
questions.explanation: Left is clockwise: Q → R → K. So K.

questions.question:
Persons K, L, M, N, O, P, Q and R sit around a circular table facing the centre, in this order clockwise: K, L, M, N, O, P, Q, R.

Who sits at the immediate right of the person opposite L?
questions.explanation: Opposite L is P. The immediate right of P (anticlockwise) is O.

questions.question:
Persons K, L, M, N, O, P, Q and R sit around a circular table facing the centre, in this order clockwise: K, L, M, N, O, P, Q, R.

How many persons sit between M and Q (clockwise from M)?
questions.explanation: Between M and Q clockwise: N, O, P = 3 persons.

questions.question:
Persons K, L, M, N, O, P, Q and R sit around a circular table facing outward, in this order clockwise: K, L, M, N, O, P, Q, R.

Who sits at the immediate left of M?
questions.explanation: Facing outward, left is anticlockwise. M's anticlockwise neighbour is L.

questions.question:
Persons K, L, M, N, O, P, Q and R sit around a circular table facing the centre, in this order clockwise: K, L, M, N, O, P, Q, R.

Who sits at the immediate left of R?
questions.explanation: Left is clockwise. After R comes K.

questions.question:
Persons K, L, M, N, O, P, Q and R sit around a circular table facing the centre, in this order clockwise: K, L, M, N, O, P, Q, R.

Who sits between P and R?
questions.explanation: Q sits between P and R.

questions.question:
Five persons A, B, C, D and E sit around a circular table facing the centre. A is second to the right of B. C is the immediate left of B. D is not adjacent to C.

Who sits at the immediate right of A?
questions.explanation: The clockwise order is A, D, B, C, E. The immediate right of A (anticlockwise) is E.

questions.question:
Five persons A, B, C, D and E sit around a circular table facing the centre. A is second to the right of B. C is the immediate left of B. D is not adjacent to C.

Who sits between A and B?
questions.explanation: In the order A, D, B, C, E, D sits between A and B.

questions.question:
Six persons A to F sit around a circular table facing the centre. A sits opposite D. B is the immediate right of A. E sits opposite B. F is not adjacent to A.

Who sits at the immediate left of E?
questions.explanation: The clockwise order is A, C, E, D, F, B. The immediate left of E (clockwise) is D.

questions.question:
Six persons A to F sit around a circular table facing the centre. A sits opposite D. B is the immediate right of A. E sits opposite B. F is not adjacent to A.

Between which two persons does F sit?
questions.explanation: In the order A, C, E, D, F, B, F is between D and B.

questions.question:
Six persons A to F sit around a circular table facing the centre. A sits opposite D. B is the immediate right of A. E sits opposite B. F is not adjacent to A.

Who sits opposite C?
questions.explanation: Opposite C (three seats away) is F.

questions.question:
Six persons A to F sit around a circular table facing the centre. A sits opposite D. B is the immediate right of A. E sits opposite B. F is not adjacent to A.

Who sits at the immediate right of A?
questions.explanation: B was stated to sit at the immediate right of A.
